skills.title: Place value up to hundreds of thousands
skills.scope: Place value and total value of digits up to hundreds of thousands; numbers up to hundreds of thousands in symbols.

skills.title: Read, order and round bigger numbers
skills.scope: Read and write numbers up to tens of thousands in words; order numbers up to tens of thousands; round to the nearest hundred and thousand.

skills.title: Divisibility tests for 2, 5 and 10
skills.scope: Apply divisibility tests of 2, 5 and 10.

skills.title: Highest common factor (HCF/GCD)
skills.scope: Find the highest common factor (greatest common divisor) of numbers.

skills.title: Least common multiple (LCM)
skills.scope: Find the least common multiple of numbers.

skills.title: Add up to 6-digit numbers
skills.scope: Add up to three 6-digit numbers without regrouping and two 6-digit numbers with double regrouping (sums up to 1,000,000); estimate by rounding to the nearest hundred and thousand; addition patterns.

skills.title: Subtract up to 6-digit numbers
skills.scope: Subtract up to 6-digit numbers without and with regrouping; estimate differences; combined addition and subtraction; subtraction patterns.

skills.title: Multiply 3-digit by 2-digit numbers
skills.scope: Multiply up to a 3-digit number by up to a 2-digit number; estimate products by rounding to the nearest ten; multiplication patterns with products up to 100.

skills.title: Divide 3-digit by 2-digit numbers
skills.scope: Divide up to a 3-digit number by up to a 2-digit number; relate multiplication and division; estimate quotients by rounding to the nearest ten.

skills.title: Combined operations
skills.scope: Combined operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of whole numbers.

skills.title: Equivalent fractions and simplifying
skills.scope: Identify equivalent fractions and simplify fractions.

skills.title: Compare and order fractions
skills.scope: Compare fractions and order fractions with denominators not exceeding 12.

skills.title: Add and subtract fractions
skills.scope: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator and with one renaming.

skills.title: Decimals: place value and order
skills.scope: Place value of decimals up to thousandths; order decimals up to thousandths.

skills.title: Add and subtract decimals
skills.scope: Add and subtract decimals up to thousandths.

skills.title: Simple equations
skills.scope: Form and solve simple equations with one unknown from real-life situations.

skills.title: Kilometres and metres
skills.scope: The kilometre as a unit; estimate distance; relate and convert kilometres and metres.

skills.title: Operations with kilometres and metres
skills.scope: Add, subtract, multiply and divide lengths in kilometres and metres.

skills.title: Area in square centimetres
skills.scope: The square centimetre; area of rectangles and squares in square centimetres.

skills.title: Volume of cubes and cuboids
skills.scope: The cubic centimetre; volume of cuboids (l x w x h) and cubes (s x s x s).

skills.title: Millilitres and litres
skills.scope: The millilitre; estimate and measure capacity in multiples of 5 millilitres; convert litres and millilitres.

skills.title: Operations with litres and millilitres
skills.scope: Add, subtract, multiply and divide capacity in litres and millilitres.

skills.title: Grams and kilograms
skills.scope: The gram; estimate and measure mass in grams; convert kilograms and grams.

skills.title: Operations with grams and kilograms
skills.scope: Add, subtract, multiply and divide mass in grams and kilograms.

skills.title: Seconds and minutes
skills.scope: The second as a unit of time; convert minutes and seconds; read time in seconds.

skills.title: Operations with minutes and seconds
skills.scope: Add, subtract, multiply and divide minutes and seconds.

skills.title: Budgets, tax and banks
skills.scope: Meaning and importance of a budget; meaning of tax; bank services; saving wisely.

skills.title: Types of lines
skills.scope: Identify and draw horizontal, vertical, perpendicular and parallel lines.

skills.title: Measuring angles in degrees
skills.scope: Relate a turn to angles; read and use a protractor; the degree as a unit; measure angles.

skills.title: 3-D objects and their shapes
skills.scope: Describe cubes, cuboids, cylinders, spheres and pyramids and the 2-D shapes found in them.

skills.title: Tally marks and frequency tables
skills.scope: Collect data of about 30 items; tables, tally marks and frequency tables; interpret them.
